Terms & Conditions

Practical terms for consultations, orders, fittings and website use.

This is a business draft for professional legal review before launch. It does not claim compliance with a specific jurisdiction.

Consultations and quotations

Consultations help define scope. A garment order begins only after design, fabric, timing, price and any deposit are agreed.

Custom garments

Made-to-measure garments are produced to agreed measurements and selections. Record customer approval for fabric, style and key details before cutting.

Fittings and alterations

The expected fitting process and included adjustments should be stated on each order. Additional design changes may affect cost and timing.

Customer-supplied fabric

Fabric supplied by a customer must be inspected for length, width, condition and suitability. Natural variation and hidden defects should be addressed in the final policy.

Delivery, cancellation and refunds

Delivery estimates may change due to material availability, fittings and events outside reasonable control. Customized-goods cancellation and refund terms require jurisdiction-specific legal review.

Website use

Website content is general information. Prices, stock, timelines and service availability must be confirmed directly with BrandON Tailors.
